freeze.authorization: User requested Step 3 and freezing the evaluation protocol.
freeze.amendment_policy: Separate version, rationale, new hash and result lineage; post-outer-result changes are exploratory and never replace v1 results.

purpose.primary_question: Does bounded model/feature/calibration refinement improve participant-balanced AP over an inner-selected fixed LR/RF baseline?
purpose.secondary_question: Does a daily regularized personal offset improve participant-balanced Brier over a smoothed personal base rate?

environment.timezone_database: Use installed IANA database; record tzdata/pytz versions in every run.

data.deduplication: pandas.drop_duplicates across all released columns, keep first, preserve file order, reset index
data.row_key: Private SHA256 of the canonical released row including metadata; never use as a model input or publish.
data.timestamps: Milliseconds since UTC epoch; convert to timezone-aware local time using each row timezone.
data_contract_errors: unlock after prompt or lock before prompt
inconsistent unlock or lock within participant/session
unknown recorded category in this fixed released file
data.error_action: Stop before model fitting; investigate and version any necessary data-contract amendment. Do not silently discard rows.
data.current_eligible_population: All 5627 deduplicated valid rows; predictors are fully reconstructible under the declared rules.
data.missing_predictor_values: Predetermined context encoding plus training-fitted numeric preprocessing; no outcome-based row filtering.
data.deterministic_row_order: Preserve original file order after exact deduplication for all fits and predictions. Private row hashes are join/provenance keys only, never sorting criteria or model inputs.

excluded_blocks: app durations/totals and switches/counts within session or today
previous-session summaries without verified upstream collection logic
pre_prompt_assumptions: Current-app categories are static lookups attached to app_at_prompt; local package/category/genre consistency is checked. Original collector code was not inspected.
features.new_or_unproven_features_after_freeze: Not admitted to v1; any later addition requires a versioned exploratory amendment.
features.inference_unknown_category: Encode all genre bits zero and app_context_missing=1; do not learn a category vocabulary from evaluation rows.
features.input_order: Exactly the selected ordered pack; fail on absent required raw columns. Ignore unrelated extra raw columns but record schema.
features.feature_selection: Only the two predeclared packs; choose pack inside inner validation. No permutation-importance-driven changes after outer results.

preprocessing.fit_scope: Current base-fit training partition only; transformations cloned per fit.
preprocessing.all_missing_training_feature: Imputer keeps the column and fills zero; scaler uses its fitted constant-column behavior.
preprocessing.training_row_sample_weight: Uniform one; candidate class_weight is additional estimator behavior. Participant-balanced weights apply to selection, calibration and specified reporting metrics.

splits.assignment: Canonical group string is str(pid), unchanged case. Sort unique groups by (SHA256(UTF8(str(seed)+"|"+namespace+"|"+pid)).hexdigest(),pid); assign index modulo n_splits. No labels or row counts enter assignment.
splits.final_calibration_scores: Reuse selected structure raw inner-held-out predictions within the full outer-training universe.
splits.small_group_count: Stop if a requested group split cannot be populated; never change fold counts based on scores.
splits.one_class_training_partition: Use declared smoothed constant predictor, retain rows and status; do not reshuffle.
splits.manifest_output: Ignored run directory only; public geometry is aggregate counts.

models.search_strategy: Exhaustive over the stored 32 structures, no adaptive extension.
models.one_class_or_empty_fit: Predict (positive_count+1)/(row_count+2); zero rows gives 0.5. Record fallback.
models.LR_nonconvergence: Retry once at max_iter=10000 with otherwise identical settings; record both warnings. If still nonconvergent, invalidate candidate.
models.unexpected_candidate_fit_failure: Candidate invalid for this outer selection if any required fit fails. Record exception type/count without publishing raw records. All candidates invalid means abort.
models.fixed_anchor_failure: Abort the run; no silent replacement.
models.caching: Reuse identical training-set, configuration and feature-pack fits; record cache provenance and prevent cross-universe reuse.

selection.weights: For every person in the assembled inner-held-out rows, each row weight is 1 / number_of_that_persons_rows; normalize only through the metric denominator.
selection.refined_structure: Maximize raw assembled inner-held-out participant-balanced AP across 32 structures.
selection.fixed_baseline_selector: Maximize the same inner AP between fixed LR and RF anchors on main_context, identity calibration; LR wins a tie.
selection.tie_break: Earliest stored structural-candidate order; time_session then main_context, LR before RF, stronger LR regularization and shallower/larger-leaf RF earlier.
selection.calibration_selection: After structural selection, compare identity with permitted nested-trained sigmoid by participant-balanced validation Brier.
selection.selection_diagnostics: Optimistic after selection; never report as independent performance.
selection.all_selection_scope: Outer-training universe only. Outer labels/features cannot alter preprocessing, candidates, hyperparameters, family, pack, calibration or cutoff.

calibration.fit_scores: Three-fold participant-cross-fitted base probabilities generated inside the current inner-training universe using the fixed selected structure. Every upstream fit excludes the inner validation people.
calibration.objective: Participant-balanced weighted mean binary log loss + 1e-4*((a-1)^2+b^2). Weights sum to one in the mean.
calibration.retain_sigmoid_if: assembled identity Brier minus sigmoid Brier > 1e-6; otherwise identity
calibration.fit_failure_or_single_class: Return identity with status; any inner sigmoid failure makes sigmoid ineligible for that outer selection. A final sigmoid failure falls back to identity with status.
calibration.final_fit: If selected, fit sigmoid on raw inner-held-out scores of the selected structure across the outer training set; never use outer-test scores or labels.
calibration.prohibited: Reusing whole-dataset global_oof[others] or assessment labels to fit the map assessed on them.
calibration.objective_numeric_form: Use stable logaddexp(0,z)-y*z at z=a*logit(clip(p))+b, plus the declared penalty; normalize participant weights to sum one.
calibration.final_failure_cutoff: If the final sigmoid fit fails, choose identity before outer application and compute the cutoff from the already saved raw inner-held-out scores; never mix a calibrated cutoff with an identity fallback.

decisions.cutoff_input: For refined procedure, nested-calibrated inner validation probabilities for the chosen map option; for fixed anchors, raw permitted inner probabilities.
decisions.ties: All tied scores at cutoff are flagged; report actual share, target is not a hard capacity cap.
decisions.known_user_personal_cutoff: Reuse that persons population refined-procedure cutoff for global, personal-rate and offset diagnostics; never use their future scores to re-match shares.

fixed_rule.expression: integer_local_hour in [0,1,2,3,4,5] OR Category_L1 == Social OR elapsed_session_minutes > 10

known_user.peer_availability: Fixed participant-excluded reference archive, including peers whose real calendar dates may be later; no prospective common-calendar claim.
known_user.day1: Local midnight of first eligible prompt; a partial first day counts as day one.
known_user.first_evaluation_day: Local day eight; evaluate every observed later day, retaining gaps in elapsed calendar days.
known_user.calendar_arithmetic: Calendar DateOffset(days=1) in the fixed first-observed study timezone, respecting DST; never fixed 86400000-millisecond increments.
known_user.history_cutoff: Midnight in the fixed first-observed study timezone for the evaluated day, converted to UTC epoch milliseconds.
known_user.history_scope: All own prior valid prompts with resolved outcomes before cutoff; cumulative, no window or decay.
known_user.same_session_on_both_sides: Contract error; stop and investigate rather than remove future rows to improve a model.

personal_offset.objective: Sum own-history binary log loss + delta^2/2; own rows have uniform weight one.
personal_offset.no_history_or_fit_failure: delta=0, return global score and status
personal_offset.one_class_history: Fit the same bounded regularized objective; do not fit a personal classifier.
personal_offset.objective_numeric_form: Sum logaddexp(0,z+delta)-y*(z+delta) over resolved own history, plus delta^2/2, where z is clipped population logit.

known_user.matching: All three variants use every identical eligible post-warmup row; no variant-specific deletion.
known_user.daily_update_time: Once at cutoff, before scoring that day; population model remains fixed.
known_user.timezone_changes: Allowed. Keep first-observed reference timezone for evaluation days/cutoffs; use each row timezone for clock predictors. Do not pick a modal timezone from future history.

metrics.within_person_eligibility: Both outcome classes on that persons complete evaluated rows; give eligible people equal weight.
metrics.within_person_day_eligibility: Both classes in that local person-day; equal weight per eligible day; report eligible days and people.
metrics.single_class_people: Retain in pooled AP, Brier, log loss and decisions.
metrics.no_positive_AP: 0 with no_positive status, preserve denominator; all-positive AP is 1.
metrics.undefined_AUC: null plus class coverage; do not substitute 0.5.

reliability.bin_weights: participant-balanced; include raw row counts and aggregate positives
reliability.empty_bins: omit from plotted points; retain counts in aggregate schema

metrics.global_test_aggregation: Assemble each persons unique outer-held-out predictions, then compute metrics; do not replace with unweighted fold-mean AP.

primary.baseline: inner-selected fixed LR/RF on main_context, identity calibration

contrasts.supporting: Fixed LR/RF anchors, fixed rule, population prior, global known-user scores and other metrics are supporting/descriptive; no post-hoc confirmatory winner.
contrasts.interpretation: Report point difference and paired interval. An interval including zero leaves improvement uncertain; no minimum score or successful improvement is required.

uncertainty.interval: 95 percent percentile [2.5,97.5] over paired metric differences
uncertainty.resampling: Sample G participants with replacement from the G evaluated participants; apply the same draws to both methods.
uncertainty.participant_balanced_bootstrap_weights: Each row of participant g receives multiplicity_g/n_rows_g; do not re-normalize each unique sampled ID to total weight one and erase multiplicity.
uncertainty.within_person_bootstrap: Resample participant-level valid paired summaries; report eligible coverage.
uncertainty.undefined_replicates: Do not redraw; report finite/undefined counts and form interval from finite values. AP no-positive convention remains zero.
uncertainty.conditional_limit: Stored predictions are resampled; models and selection are not refitted, so intervals do not include full training/selection variability.
uncertainty.inferential_scope: One primary comparison; secondary/supporting comparisons are explicitly identified and not independent confirmations.

order: validate sealed protocol and data hashes
implement and pass risk-focused data/split tests
fit fixed anchors and bounded inner candidates
choose structure/map/cutoffs wholly inside outer training
apply each outer procedure once and save private predictions
perform predetermined known-user daily comparison using excluded-fold population artifacts
produce aggregate metrics, paired uncertainty and figures
independent correctness review before writing final report
execution.fit_budget_explanation: 5*(32 structures*3 inner fits + selected-structure 3 inner-training calibrations*3 calibration folds + up to 3 final refits). Final map reuses selected raw inner OOF scores. Calibration optimizations and daily one-parameter offsets are separate; record actual counts.
execution.later_outer_inspection: No new candidates, features, day conventions or thresholds in v1 after outer results.

outputs.privacy_guard: Check intended Git files for raw records, IDs, exact timestamps, app package names and serialized fitted artifacts before publication.
outputs.reports: No submission or contact is authorized by freezing this protocol.

acceptance_tests_required_before_trainin: future-label mutation leaves earlier personal predictions unchanged
strict lock cutoff including equality and unresolved outcomes
disjoint session identities across each history/evaluation boundary
timezone, DST, partial first day and midnight versus 04:00 fixtures
training-only imputation, scaling and feature order
one-class/empty histories, all-negative validation, ties and zero alerts
matched masks/labels across methods and count reconciliation
known_limitations: Previously explored data; retrospective internal validation only.
Current-app availability relies on released semantics and consistency, not original collector inspection.
Conservative input restriction changes the comparison with the historical 49-feature pipeline.
Reference peer archive is not a calendar-prospective simulation.
Sampled check-ins and predicted high-gap labels do not demonstrate intervention benefit.
Original HW5 template and Mac audit are unavailable locally; template requirements are inherited from the checked handoff.
Implementation does not yet exist; protocol preflight cannot establish implementation correctness.
Evaluation-day midnight is anchored to the first observed timezone; during travel it can differ from the current phone timezone.
